item: a pending-resume watcher that cannot be started no longer leaves a resume claimed that nothing waits on
summary: _watch_for_resume published _RESUME_PENDING (what the Schedule tab and status()[resume_pending] show as 'collection starts again the moment that pass exits') and then started the oo-resume-watch thread; Thread.start() raises RuntimeError before the target runs when the process is out of threads, so the claim stayed for the life of the process with no watcher behind it and the error escaped resume_after_exclusive_operation into the finally of the backup or restore that called it. The claim is now retracted (unless a newer watcher published its own), the caller logs that nothing is waiting and that collection stays stopped until started again, and the hold is still given back. Found by the scan of runner.py's other Thread.start() sites after #1634; the other sites (start(), run_now, storage_guard supervisor and its drain, CollectionMonitor) were read and are either self-healing or hold no lock. 3 tests, 3 mutants killed.
